summary: BBCMS Mortgage Trust 2026-5C42 filed a routine 8-K reporting that, effective September 30, 2026, the Franklin 8 Pack Whole Loan — a whole loan comprising the trust's Franklin 8 Pack Mortgage Loan plus two pari passu notes held outside the trust — moved to servicing under a separate pooling and servicing agreement. The trust, formed June 24, 2026, holds 36 commercial, multifamily and manufactured housing mortgage loans, with Midland as master servicer, LNR as special servicer and Computershare as trustee. No price, stake, premium or board recommendation is stated; this is an ordinary servicing-transfer notice, not a special situation, with no deal terms and no risk-arb angle.
